hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in */chapters/*.md) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && python3 build.py >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac
echo 'Handbook repo. Never edit index.html or build/ - both are generated. House rules and callout semantics are in CLAUDE.md; re-read before writing prose.'

i=$(cat)
[ "$(printf %s "$i" | jq -r ".stop_hook_active // false")" = true ] && exit 0
t=$(printf %s "$i" | jq -r ".transcript_path // \"\"")
[ -f "$t" ] || exit 0
m=$(grep -E "\"type\"[ ]*:[ ]*\"assistant\"" "$t" | tail -n 1 | jq -r "[.message.content[]? | select(.type==\"text\") | .text] | join(\"\n\")" 2>/dev/null)
[ -n "$m" ] || exit 0
re="(want|shall|should|would you like)[^.?!]{0,40}(commit|push)[^.?!]{0,30}[?]|^[ \t]*(commit|push)([ \t]+and[ \t]+push)?[ \t]*[?][ \t]*$"
printf %s "$m" | jq -Rse --arg re "$re" "split(\"\n\") | map(select(test(\"[^ \t]\"))) | (last // \"\") | test(\$re; \"i\")" >/dev/null || exit 0
jq -n --arg r "Standing preference: never ask the user whether to commit. Replace that question with the command itself — reply with nothing but a bash code block containing a single ready-to-run: git add -A && git commit -m \"<message describing the actual current diff>\". No preamble, no explanation, no follow-up question." "{decision: \"block\", reason: \$r}"
